A) **Yes.** The flowsheet is drawn inside a single, large, dark rounded-rect container with a visible border and subtle shadow.
B) **No.** All labels (F‑101, E‑101, V‑101, stream numbers, product tags), the title block, and the legend are cleanly spaced with no overlap or clipping.

**Screenshot 2 (Distillation Column)**
A) **Yes.** The flowsheet occupies one coherent sheet box (single rounded rect with fill, border, and shadow).
B) **No.** Text is fully legible; unit tags, stream numbers, and the title block are well-positioned without any overlap or layout issues.

**Screenshot 3 (AI Builder – Waiting State)**
A) **Yes.** The “THE SHEET IS WAITING” message is centered inside a single large rounded-rect sheet box with border and shadow.
B) **No.** The waiting-state text and the surrounding UI elements (sidebar cards, header, input field) show no text overlap, clipping, or layout regression.
